description: T-33A-1-LO; 4737th ABW; struck off charge 16 November 1967 at Springfield Illinois and preserved in Quincy Illinois; Baugher states currently on display with VFW Post 9392 Lowell Wisconsin falsely marked as 979392 so the number painted on the aircraft is not its serial
With 1-147th Aviation Battalion Wisconsin Army National Guard at Truax Field by August 1994 then at an unknown date to VFW Post 9392 Lowell Wisconsin
